senses.gloss: amṛta-gaṇa (SII 12), same as Tamil amirta-gaṇattār (SITI), members of the committee for the management of village affairs; members in charge of the cash-receipts of a temple.

amṛta-paḍi, cf. Tamil amuda-ppaḍi (SII 1; SITI), raw rice; food offering to a deity; (CITD), paḍi is an allowance in food (i. e. all the necessary commodities to prepare a meal) and sometimes also in money and amuda-paḍi is an endowment often made in favour of a deity for daily offering of food as bhoga, etc.
amṛta-yoga (EI 9), a particular time regarded as auspicious.
